title: Tempeh satay bowl
summary: Tempeh satay bowl is a thai dinner built around tempeh and peanut butter, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook tempeh for Tempeh satay bowl in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm lime juice alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss peanut butter with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.

Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Tempeh satay bowl straight away. Taste Tempeh satay bowl before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.

image.alt: Tempeh satay bowl served for dinner
